open_findings.detail: resources() assumes memory.current and memory.max exist at /sys/fs/cgroup. Linux cgroup v2 specifies them for non-root cgroups; a hosted VM may expose the real hierarchy root rather than the current container namespace. The actual process cgroup and ancestor limits must be resolved, or unsupported observation must remain an explicit failure. Missing files must not be silently treated as unlimited. The pre-ENTRY wrapper read can fail before structured result creation.
